profile.headline: Engineering Team Lead, Rutgers Graduate (Computer Science, Mathematics, and Computer Engineering)
profile.summary:
Full stack engineer to the extreme. I have a diverse and colorful background in multiple areas of technology and domain experience. From leading frontend SPAs, micro-service backends, database migrations & setups, dockerization, and all the way to low level embedded development - with everything in between! 

My natural curiosity drives me to find new domains to apply my technical craft, from drones and military aircrafts, to fintech, healthcare, project management software and more.

Not your typical siloed engineer, I am a very extroverted and friendly individual who enjoys working cross-collaboratively across the stack taking time to deep dive in the details while also working to communicate those complexities to outside stakeholders.

Leading and mentoring is second nature. I love helping others and coming up with new ways to explain complex topics. 

Checkout some of my tutorials at:
Riverian Programming - Programming Blog and Software guides.
riverianprogramming.wordpress.com

YouTube Channel - Where I host mathematical and computer science tutorials and explanations.
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCqjc9tKzh_c5S3g9xIyKsKg/videos

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
First NYC Engineer, built out the team, interview pipeline, & K's first Internship program.
Mentored reports, help outline their career trajectory, and provide insight for areas of growth & interest. Which allowed for matching the right people to the right problem. 

Selected to be part of the Tech Cabinet were leaders can make RFCs to gain support for company wide improvements such as:
-component library with storybook for easy UI sharing across different teams/projects
-core architecture for the Web platform using lerna for a multi-package mono-repo that unlocked parallel multi-team development 

Launched analytics service for Segment Automation and transforming/backfilling data for Braze.

Led a clinical automation project that streamlined refills using a questionnaire that interfaced with the mobile app, stripe API for payments, and it was successfully developed \& launched with in one month.

Contributed to the breakdown of the monolithic architecture by creating a micro service API for unified accounts that handled session tokens that was used by both the mobile app (web view) & web (redirect).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Removed pain points for email marketers having to go through backend engineers for email campaigns by migrated logic off of a custom in house micro service written in scala to use the Ongage Web Portal.

Data/Reports not natively available through ongage was constructed using a new service written in NodeJS/TS that pulled data from the ongage API and other in house sources. Output data/reports were long polled for aggregate user activity and was then stored in a postgres db, that was denormalized to a redshift server using fivetran for looker access.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Aircraft Mission Support - WPF C# Software Engineer:
Contributing to the modernization of a proprietary military aircraft mission planning systems that
utilized C++ with MFC, KML, STL, and ATL libraries.

Developing code for a standalone flight brief/debrief application, which provides post-flight mission
support for advanced pilot training, using both C# WPF/XAML framework and OpenGVS/OpenGL.

Created the Sortie Graph which gives a visual representation of the flight parameters, the audio/video
managers for post flight media synchronization, and created an XML Configuration system to make
the application more customizable.

Spearheaded/lead the team’s testing automation efforts for CI/CD (Continuous Integration/Deployment) using Python with the Squish tool.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
GSMO DISA Storefront – React/JavaScript Software Engineer:
Lead a small project from creation to completion, with a tight schedule and on budget.

Designed the Frontend Architecture using React, Client Routing, Redux(State Management), and Sagas.

Wrote a Mock REST API in NodeJS/Express to allow the Frontend to be developed faster and independently of the legacy Backend system updates.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Used HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python CGI, and SQL(querying and combining multiple databases) to
create a portal to manage and display metrics, which is currently in use by the regional cloud director.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Worked on the first air and water drone - the Naviator

Created custom firmware from scratch and reverse engineered ESC Hardware (Electronic speed controller).

Developed software and designed new hardware to give the drone more fine control over lower speeds in hightorque environments (under-water) and smooth movements to allow for more precise movements.

I started off as part of the research internship, and through my efforts and contributions was offered a full-time research assistant position when the summer ended.
